conventions.axes: Y-up, right-handed; camera looks down -Z by default; ground is the XZ plane at y = 0
conventions.lightIntensity: three.js physical units (directional/hemisphere/ambient: lux-like; spot/point: candela, decay 2)
conventions.easing: named functions from kit/time.js `ease` (formulas in references/kit-api.md)
conventions.camera: fov is vertical field of view in degrees (three.js convention); sensor-agnostic

style.name: Felt & Stitch
style.description: A handmade felt story board: thick wool-felt cut-outs with fuzzy edges, layered and appliquéd onto a felt backdrop, held down with raised embroidery stitches in contrasting floss, plus buttons, beads and pom-poms; animated on twos with floppy fabric settles and stitch-by-stitch sewing.

bump.description: fine birch grain for the embroidery hoop

fibre.description: short streaky fibres in four directions (freq per m, stretch along the fibre, ridge sharpness) + fine grain; bump heights in metres; object space

mottle.description: low-frequency dye/density mottling and light/dark fibre speckle (fraction of albedo)

fuzz.description: fuzzy halo: shells pushed out along smooth normals; alpha = fibre noise x fresnel (dense at silhouettes, a faint fibre haze on faces)

pucker.description: dark dimple decal where the thread enters the felt, in radii

sfx.pat: thud(pitch 1.6) + paper(dense, low): soft fabric pat
sfx.pull: whoosh(short, high, q 3) + tick: thread pull

motion: Object motion is quantised to 15 poses/s (on twos); the camera glides at 30 fps.
Pieces arrive by flopping down onto the board from a hinge (soft underdamped settle) and leave by peeling up.
Things are sewn on: a needle travels along the edge and stitches appear one by one (reveal = f(t)), a thread trailing from the eye.
Characters hop with anticipation, a soft stretch and a squashy landing; while 'working' they wobble and shed little pom-poms and felt sparks.
Paths between things are dashed running stitches sewn on first; items then travel along them.
Labels are embroidered backstitch letters on felt patches (stroke font) or felt letter cut-outs; never flat type.

objects.procedural: felt backdrop: teal wool-felt slab 14.4 x 8.2 m, plum felt border band with a cream running stitch, scalloped forest-green felt ground strip with a leaf running stitch

notes.posing: Object motion is evaluated at tq = floor(t*15)/15 (on twos); the camera uses t.
